title: Google Ads Agency for Small Business: What You Need to Know | Bold Thinkers Group Blog

facts.fact: According to WordStream's 2026 Google Ads benchmarks (a third-party source cited by the vendor), the average cost per click for search ads in 2026 is $5.42.
facts.quote: the average cost per click (CPC) for search ads in 2026 is **$5.42**

facts.fact: The same WordStream report, as cited by the vendor, puts the average cost per click for Attorneys and Legal Services at $9.87.
facts.quote: the same report puts Attorneys and Legal Services at **$9.87** per click

facts.fact: The same WordStream report, as cited by the vendor, puts the average cost per click for Home and Home Improvement at $8.33.
The vendor states that $1,000–$5,000 in monthly ad spend is a functional starting range for most local service businesses.
facts.quote: **Monthly ad spend:** $1,000–$5,000 is a functional starting range for most local service businesses

facts.fact: Bold Thinkers Group reports that across its veterinary Google Ads accounts, it averages $14.32 per lead.
facts.quote: Across our veterinary Google Ads accounts, we average **$14.32** per lead.

facts.fact: The vendor states that agencies usually charge either a percentage of ad spend or a flat monthly fee for management, without giving a specific rate.
facts.quote: Agencies usually charge either a percentage of ad spend or a flat monthly fee.

facts.fact: Bold Thinkers Group offers a free 15-minute strategy chat for Tampa Bay businesses.
facts.quote: Free Strategy Session: 15-Minute Strategy Chat for Tampa Bay Businesses

facts.fact: The page describes Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) as a free listing that appears in local search results and on Google Maps.
facts.quote: the free listing that appears in local search results and on Google Maps

facts.fact: The article was published on October 12, 2026 and last updated on October 22, 2026.
